name: obsidian-vault-changelog
description: Maintain a changelog of recently edited notes in Obsidian
author: Mark Ayers

scripts.dev: bun build src/main.ts --outdir . --format cjs --external obsidian --external electron --sourcemap=linked --watch
scripts.build: bun run check && bun build src/main.ts --outdir . --format cjs --external obsidian --external electron --minify
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && biome check . && prettier --check "**/*.md"
scripts.deploy: set -a && . ./.env.local && set +a && bun run build && mkdir -p "${OBSIDIAN_DEPLOY_DEST:?set it in .env.local}" && cp main.js manifest.json "$OBSIDIAN_DEPLOY_DEST"
